title: 부-, 불-, 무-, 비-: '아님·없음'을 나타내는 한자어 접두사
objective: By the end, you can understand ten common words that start with 부-, 불-, 무-, or 비-, and choose the right one to describe a problem, a plan, or a person's behavior in a short sentence.
summary: Learn ten useful words made with the negative Sino-Korean prefixes 부-, 불-, 무-, and 비-, and use them in everyday sentences.

task.title: Use the right word
task.line: Read each sentence and fill in or choose the word from the list that fits the meaning.

words.meaning: to be inaccurate, wrong in details
words.exampleMeaning: The map information was inaccurate, so I got lost.
They say the accident was caused by the driver's carelessness.
That kind of joke is inappropriate during a meeting.

words.meaning: to be irregular, not at set times
words.example: 요즘 식사 시간이 불규칙해서 속이 자주 아파요.
words.exampleMeaning: My mealtimes are irregular these days, so my stomach often hurts.

words.example: 이 일을 내일까지 다 끝내는 건 불가능해요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's impossible to finish all this work by tomorrow.
I got rid of things I didn't need before moving.

words.example: 환경 문제에 대한 사람들의 무관심이 걱정이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm worried about how little people care about environmental problems.
Breaking promises again and again is irresponsible.
This meeting will be held behind closed doors.

words.example: 한 달에 10킬로그램을 빼는 건 비현실적인 계획이에요.
words.exampleMeaning: Losing 10 kilograms in one month is an unrealistic plan.

exercises: Fill in the blank with a word from the list (write it without 하다): 제 동생은 자는 시간이 ____해서 늘 피곤해해요.
Choose the right word (불가능 / 불필요): 비행기 표가 다 팔려서 오늘 출발하는 건 ____해요.
Choose the right word (무책임 / 무관심) for each sentence: ① 어린아이를 혼자 집에 두고 나간 건 ____한 행동이에요. ② 그 가수는 사람들의 평가에 ____해서 전혀 신경 쓰지 않아요.
Choose the right word (비공개 / 비현실적): 오늘 리허설은 ____로 해서 기자들이 들어올 수 없었어요.
Change 부정확하다 to the -아/어서 form to fit the blank: 계산이 ____ 다시 확인해야 해요.
Choose the right word (부적절해요 / 비현실적이에요): 결혼식에 운동복을 입고 가는 건 ____.
